1.title: The Sun
1.short: Leadership, originality and a strong individual identity.
1.description: A powerful, self-made number. It gives command, creativity and the courage to walk alone. Success comes through your own initiative, never by depending on others.

2.title: The Moon
2.short: Gentle, intuitive and cooperative, but changeable.
2.description: Brings imagination, sensitivity and the ability to work with people. The weakness is a restless, changing mind and lack of firm decision.

3.title: Jupiter
3.description: A fortunate number for knowledge, teaching, law and finance. It rewards discipline and honest ambition, and gives respect in society.

4.title: Rahu
4.description: Gives an original, rebellious mind. Life moves in sudden jumps. Excellent for technology and reform, risky for documents, loans and partnerships.

5.title: Mercury
5.short: Quick, commercial, adaptable and lucky in trade.
5.description: The most flexible and friendly vibration. Brings recovery from any setback, speed in business, and the power to convince people.

6.title: Venus
6.description: Brings beauty, luxury, magnetism and family happiness. Warns against indulgence and over-attachment.

7.title: Ketu
7.description: Gives intuition, research ability and detachment. Money can be irregular, but insight and originality are exceptional.

8.title: Saturn
8.description: A hard-working, karmic number. Results arrive slowly and only through honesty and patience — but what it gives, it does not take back.

9.title: Mars
9.short: Courage, energy and the fighting spirit.
9.description: Gives stamina, protection and victory after conflict. The danger is anger, haste and accidents.

10.title: The Wheel of Fortune
10.short: Rise and fall — honour, faith and self-confidence.
10.description: A number of honour, faith and self-confidence. Your name will be known — for good or bad. Plans are likely to be carried out, but the wheel keeps turning, so never grow complacent at the top.

11.title: A Lion Muzzled / The Clenched Fist
11.short: Hidden dangers, trials and treachery from others.
11.description: A warning number. It indicates trials, treachery and hidden danger from other people. Great inner strength is available, but you will be tested repeatedly before you are trusted.

12.title: The Sacrifice / The Victim
12.short: Anxiety of mind, sacrifice for others.
12.description: Signifies suffering and anxiety of mind. You are often sacrificed for the plans or intrigues of others. Beware of false flattery and of carrying loads that are not yours.

13.title: Regeneration / Change
13.short: Upheaval and change — power if used unselfishly.
13.description: Not an unlucky number as popularly believed, but a number of upheaval and change. It warns of the unknown. Used unselfishly it gives power; used for self-interest alone it destroys.

14.title: Movement / Combination
14.description: Indicates movement, combination of people and things, and dealings with money. Fortunate for trade and travel, but speculation and gambling bring danger, as do natural forces such as fire, water and storms.

15.title: The Magician
15.short: Magnetism, eloquence and gifts from others.
15.description: A number of magic and personal magnetism. Excellent for obtaining money, gifts and favours. Gives eloquence and a dramatic personality — but if used with a material 4 or 8, it can turn manipulative.

16.title: The Shattered Citadel
16.short: Warning of accidents and defeat of plans.
16.description: A gravely warning number. It shows a tower struck by lightning — a fall from a high place and the collapse of plans. Make plans in advance, never depend on one support, and avoid arrogance.

17.title: The Star of the Magi
17.description: A highly spiritual and fortunate number. It gives the power to rise above every difficulty and setback. Its name outlives the person — a number of legacy and immortality.

18.title: Materialism Destroying Spirituality
18.description: A difficult vibration warning of quarrels with family, deception from trusted people, and danger from fire, explosion and water. Advancement comes only through absolute honesty; otherwise gains are lost as quickly as won.

19.title: The Prince of Heaven
19.description: One of the most fortunate compound numbers. It promises success, honour, esteem and happiness in undertakings. Obstacles are overcome and recognition arrives.

20.title: The Awakening
20.short: A call to a new purpose and higher plan.
20.description: The judgement — an awakening to a new purpose. Delays and obstacles appear, but there is a powerful call to action for a greater cause. Not the best for worldly wealth alone.

21.title: The Crown of the Magi
21.short: Victory after long struggle; advancement and honour.
21.description: A number of advancement, honour and elevation in life. Victory comes after long struggle and persistent effort — but it does come, and it is lasting.

22.title: Caution / The Good Man Blinded
22.short: Illusion and delusion — living in a fool's paradise.
22.description: A warning of illusion. A good person, blindfolded, who fails to see the danger at their feet. Judge situations on evidence, not on hope, and verify every promise made to you.

23.title: The Royal Star of the Lion
23.description: One of the luckiest of all compound numbers. It promises success, help from those in higher positions, and protection from those above you. Excellent for a personal or business name.

24.title: Gain Through Love
24.short: Fortunate — gain through love and association.
24.description: A very fortunate number. It promises assistance and advancement through those of rank and position, and gain through love and the opposite sex. Favourable for partnership and marriage.

25.title: Strength Through Experience
25.short: Success after early struggle and hard lessons.
25.description: Gives strength gained through experience and worldly wisdom. Early life brings tests and losses, but the discrimination developed makes later success solid. Good, but not lucky in a quick sense.

26.title: Gravest Warnings
26.short: Losses through partnership and bad advice.
26.description: A number of grave warnings for the future. It foreshadows disasters brought about by association with others, ruin through bad speculation, partnerships and unreliable advice. Save for the future and take no financial risk on another's word.

27.title: The Sceptre
27.short: Authority, command and reward for creative work.
27.description: A promising number of authority, power and command. It indicates that reward will come from the creative intellect. Carry out your own ideas and plans — do not be intimidated by the opposition of others.

28.title: The Trusting Lamb
28.short: You have to start your projects again and again to get success.
28.description: A number full of contradictions. It gives great promise, good intellect and the talent to succeed — but there is loss through misplaced trust in others, opposition, and the danger of having to begin all over again. This person has to start their projects again and again before success finally holds. Keep contracts in writing, insure what you build, and never lend your name.

29.title: Grace Under Trial
29.description: Indicates uncertainties, treachery and deception from others. Trials and tribulations from unreliable friends and unhappiness in relationships. Great grace is available, but only after the tests are faced honestly.

30.title: Thoughtful Deduction
30.short: Mental superiority — but material results are optional.
30.description: A number of thoughtful deduction, retrospection and mental superiority over others. It is neither fortunate nor unfortunate materially — the person often places no value on worldly things by choice, and can be self-contained and lonely.

31.title: The Recluse
31.description: Similar to 30, but even more self-contained, lonely and isolated from others. Very fortunate for spiritual and creative pursuits, less so for worldly ambition.

32.title: The Communication Star
32.short: Magical power to unite people — hold to your own plan.
32.description: Has magical power like 5 and 14. Associated with combinations of people and nations. Fortunate if the person holds firmly to their own judgement and plans; if they allow others' opinions to change their course, the plans fail.

33.title: Gain Through Love
33.description: Carries the same meaning as 24. Assistance from persons of rank and position, gain through love and partnership, and favourable outcomes in relationships.

34.title: Strength Through Experience
34.description: Carries the same meaning as 25 — strength earned through experience, testing early, stable later.

35.title: Gravest Warnings
35.description: Carries the same meaning as 26. Losses through partnerships, bad speculation and misplaced trust in advisors.

36.title: The Sceptre
36.short: Same vibration as 27 — authority and reward.
36.description: Carries the same meaning as 27. Authority, command, and reward for the creative intellect.

37.title: Good Friendship
37.short: Fortunate in friendship, partnership and love.
37.description: A fortunate number of good and lasting friendships. Excellent for partnerships, associations and all matters of love and the opposite sex.

38.title: Grace Under Trial
38.description: Carries the same meaning as 29 — deception, unreliable people and trials in relationships.

39.title: Thoughtful Deduction
39.description: Carries the same meaning as 30 — mental superiority, detachment from material gain.

40.title: The Recluse
40.description: Carries the same meaning as 31 — isolation, self-containment, spiritual depth.

41.title: The Communication Star
41.description: Carries the same meaning as 32 — magnetic power to combine people, provided you hold to your own plan.

42.title: Gain Through Love
42.description: Carries the same meaning as 24 — advancement through those of rank and gain through love.

43.title: Revolution and Upheaval
43.description: An unfortunate number symbolising revolution, upheaval, conflict and failure. Strongly advised against as a name number for a person or business.

44.title: Gravest Warnings
44.description: Carries the same meaning as 26 — ruin through partnerships and bad advice.

45.title: The Sceptre
45.description: Carries the same meaning as 27 — command, authority and reward from creative intelligence.

46.title: Good Friendship
46.description: Carries the same meaning as 37 — fortunate friendships and partnerships.

47.title: Grace Under Trial
47.description: Carries the same meaning as 29 — deception and trials from unreliable associates.

48.title: Thoughtful Deduction
48.description: Carries the same meaning as 30 — intellectual strength, material indifference.

49.title: The Recluse
49.description: Carries the same meaning as 31 — solitude and inner richness.

50.title: The Communication Star
50.short: Same vibration as 32 — powerful for connection and reach.
50.description: Carries the same meaning as 32. Magical power in communication and in bringing people together. Very strong for a mobile number or a media/marketing brand, as long as you stick to your own plan.

51.title: The Warrior's Number
51.description: A powerful number of sudden advancement, promotion and leadership. Excellent for those in command — but it makes enemies, so protection and discretion are necessary.

52.title: Revolution and Upheaval
52.description: Carries the same meaning as 43 — upheaval, conflict and failure. Not advisable as a name number.
